## Embedded BOM review

- Report BOM description coverage separately from scope terminology matches, so
  labeled items are not mistaken for confirmed scope.
- Treat quantities stated as required or determined in the field as intentionally
  unstated, and omit approximate-length review notes.

**Full changelog:** https://github.com/MaddogSTD/engineering-app/compare/v0.1.26...v0.1.27
